#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1)
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    string p_str, k_str;
    cin >> p_str >> k_str;
    long long p_int = stoll(p_str);
    long long k_int = stoll(k_str);

    if (k_int == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p_int, p_int - 1, MOD_CONST) << "\n";
    } else if (k_int == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p_int, p_int, MOD_CONST) << "\n";
    } else {
        long long n = k_int;
        long long order_count = 1;
        while (n != 1) {
            n = (n * k_int) % p_int;
            order_count++;
        }
        long long repeats = (p_int - 1) / order_count;
        cout << mod_pow(p_int, repeats, MOD_CONST) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
